title: Signed-out visitors on a Space's sub-pages and the /events index get the Frequency site chrome instead of DAWN's header around an unstyled members body

source.ref: Live scan of frequencylocal.com 2026-10-14 (513 sitemap URLs): every /spaces/<slug>/<tab> page (contact, book, calendar, circles, memberships, collaborators, custom pages, 64 in the sitemap) and /events rendered with no data-kit root, under DAWN's header and footer.

detail: The (main) layout's publicChrome (the signed-out branch for leftover public views: Space profile tabs and the /events index) still drew DAWN's SiteHeader, MarketingFooter and three-column gutter under SITE_DESIGN=frequency. The bodies inside are members-kit bodies (FqSpaceChrome, FqEventsBody) whose CSS is scoped to [data-kit="members"], which only the signed-in MembersKitRoot provides, so /events rendered as raw unstyled links and the Space tabs showed a squeezed, overlapping cover under the old header. Under Frequency publicChrome now returns SiteShell surface="commons" (as app/(public)/layout.tsx does) with a data-kit="members" root on Commons inside it; DAWN keeps its chrome unchanged.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('app/(main)/layout.tsx','utf8');const i=s.indexOf('const publicChrome');const seg=s.slice(i,s.indexOf('<SiteHeader variant',i));if(!/SITE_DESIGN === 'frequency'/.test(seg)||!/<SiteShell surface=.commons.>/.test(seg)||!/data-kit=.members./.test(seg)){console.error('SCAN-869: signed-out public views in (main) still wear DAWN chrome under Frequency');process.exit(1)}"
